Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
Original model by NVIDIA: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3
CoreML conversion by FluidInference: https://huggingface.co/FluidInference/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-coreml
Model license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
ToSpeech uses the converted model with an INT8 encoder and does not modify the weights.
FluidAudio Swift runtime: https://github.com/FluidInference/FluidAudio (Apache 2.0).
The model is downloaded separately on request; recognition runs locally.
